items.title: P10 · E9 — Principal Context Enrichment (Device Posture · Network Zone · Purpose)
items.description: Add device_trust, network_zone, and purpose as first-class context fields on the resolved principal so policy and consent can condition on them. Addresses Reality Report v2 §7.10; purpose feeds the E3 consent-gating decision input.

items.title: P10 · E8 — Observability, Audit & Lineage Taxonomy + Telemetry Portal
items.description: Implement the critique's 8-type observability taxonomy over the existing audit/trace/lineage/meter spine: end-to-end OpenTelemetry tracing, Grafana/Prometheus dashboards, security detection over the SIEM forwarder, plus MDM and consent observability. Addresses Analyze2 §3.11 and Reality Report v2 §4.7.

items.title: P10 · E7 — Non-Breaking Integration & Regression Hardening
items.description: Guarantee the P10 changes are additive and break no existing SDK/service: optional obligations/token, additive-only DB migrations, cross-SDK integration & regression suite, and a CI gate requiring full build + isolation/chaos suites green.

items.title: P10 · E6 — Healthcare EMPI / Probabilistic MDM
items.description: Extend sdk-identity-resolver with probabilistic patient matching for multi-source data: confidence scores, POSSIBLY_SAME candidate links (never forced merges), sdk-approval-governed steward review, reversible merge/unmerge as compensating events, and match-quality calibration. Required for the healthcare vertical (Architecture v3.2 §11A.10).

items.title: P10 · E5 — Resource Ownership Registry (GitOps, No-Owner-No-Resource)
items.description: A platform.resource_registry where every infra resource carries owner/team/repo/terraform_module/cost_center/classification/expiry; GitOps reconciler quarantines orphan/expired resources; OC-12 lint blocks unregistered resources. Implements Architecture v3.2 §11A.8 + OC-12.

items.title: P10 · E4 — Fail-Closed PDP & Audited Break-Glass
items.description: Formalize fail-closed-on-evaluator-error for sensitive resource classes, short-TTL cached decisions for low-risk, and an explicit audited break-glass path via sdk-approval (scoped, time-bounded, certificate-of-action). Implements Architecture v3.2 §11A.6.

items.title: P10 · E3 — Consent-Gated Authorization (Purpose-Bound, Fail-Closed)
items.description: Wire sdk-consent receipts into the sdk-policy decision as a first-class purpose-gated input; missing/revoked receipt fails closed for purpose-bound resources. Includes the healthcare purpose taxonomy (HIPAA TPO + 42 CFR Part 2). Implements Architecture v3.2 §11A.5 + P18; Required for the healthcare vertical (§11A.10).

items.title: P10 · E2 — Platform Principal Token (Minted, Audience-Bound Internal Identity)
items.description: Gateway mints a signed, short-TTL, audience-bound token from the resolved IdentityContext; downstream services verify it instead of trusting forwarded headers. Closes the confused-deputy class (Scenario 5). Implements Architecture v3.2 §11A.4 + P17.

items.title: P10 · E1 — Obligation-Based Authorization (Mask/Filter/TTL on Decisions)
items.description: Extend the access mesh so policy decisions return obligations (mask_fields, row_filter, audit_level, ttl_seconds), not just ALLOW/DENY. Server-side enforcement of masking/filtering; UI visibility becomes advisory only. Closes the field-leak risk (critique Scenario 7). Implements Architecture v3.2 §11A.3 + P16 + OC-11.

items.title: P9.2 · Agent Discovery Surface (MCP Payloads, Ingest, Hot Path)
items.description: Expose payload contracts, ingest targets, and a no-latency hot path to coding/ETL agents via the registry MCP. New tools: get_endpoint(sdk,path) returns method+path+payload+auth scope; search_sdks(kind=ingest) restricts to ingest endpoints; get_ingest_targets(entity) answers 'where do I push these records, with what payload?'. The agent hot path is an in-process index (sub-ms, zero network) backed by the pgvector store as source-of-truth; MCP instances reload on a catalog.sdk version bump / LISTEN. Includes an ETL agent discovery flow + example. See §14.4.

items.title: P9.2 · Intent-to-SDK Planner v2 (Retrieve-then-Compose)
items.description: Replace the /build planner's single flat-catalog LLM call (all ~90 SDKs in one ~18k-token prompt, returns only ~3 SDKs) with a retrieve-then-compose pipeline: embed intent locally, pgvector top-K, then compose from candidates only (~3-4k tokens, deterministic). Add two resolvers between retrieve and compose so cross-cutting concerns the user never typed always surface: foundation-tier injection (identity/persona-AIM/tenant/rebac regardless of score) and dependency-closure expansion (walk manifest consumes/event graph). Split output: recommend auth SDKs, list login/admin page UI as custom work. Generation provider is swappable behind an adapter. See §14.3.

items.title: P9.2 · Manifest Contract Enrichment — Payloads & Ingest
items.description: Close the two discovery gaps. Gap A: manifest endpoints carry only {method,path,description}; add request_schema/response_schema (JSON Schema, generated from each SDK's Zod/TS types) plus auth_scopes so agents call APIs correctly instead of guessing. Gap B: nothing marks where external data enters; add an endpoint.kind classifier (ingest|bulk|query|mutation|webhook) and a first-class sdk-ingest batch endpoint (idempotent upsert envelope) backed by sdk-lineage + sdk-audit, so ETL agents can discover import targets. Bumps the sdk-capability schema. See §14.2.

items.title: P9.2 · SDK Catalog RAG Store & Auto-Sync
items.description: Evolve the L2 SDK registry from a build-time file artifact into an auto-populated, auto-refreshed Postgres + pgvector RAG store in the global-catalog pool. The catalog.* schema is auto-created on boot by migration-runner (no manual SQL). A sync job reuses the sdk-registry scanner to upsert SDK/endpoint/scenario rows, content-hash diffed so only changed SDKs re-embed. Embeddings use the local in-process bge-small-en-v1.5 model (vector(384), HNSW) so a generation-LLM provider change never breaks discovery. Reuses the sdk-knowledge-rag VectorBackend interface via a new PgvectorBackend. See docs/v3.1/SDK-Discoverability-AI-Builder-v3.1.html §14.1.

items.title: Tenant-BYOK for AI Provider Keys
items.description: Add per-tenant LLM provider credentials with vault-wrapped storage, write-only admin UI, fallthrough to platform credentials, audit emission, and meter SKU switch. Extends sdk-ai-gateway, sdk-secrets, sdk-meter, and tenant-admin. See docs/v3.1/prd/Tenant-BYOK-AI-Keys.md for the full PRD.

items.title: P9 · E7 — Cross-cutting: Projexlight Dogfood + ai-appgen Migration + ~70 Manifest Backlog
items.description: The three cross-cutting workstreams that span the phase: (a) ~70 hand-authored SDK capability manifests via distributed authoring + central review per Q-5 (mitigates R-1); (b) Projexlight rebuild on ProjexCloud SDKs via the prd-management blueprint — the dogfood pilot validating the model end-to-end (cutover deferred to P9.1 week 64 per Q-8); (c) ai-appgen migration recipe + white-glove for top 5–10 tenants + EOL announcement at P9 GA → sunset at P10 per Q-10. Also owns Doctrine §C (Capability-First) and §D (Composition over Coupling) Architecture WG sign-off. Source: PRD §5.7, §5.8 + Q-5 mitigation in §11 R-1. Closes AC-11 (P9.1 gate) + manifest authoring portion of AC-1.

items.title: P9 · E6 — Layer 4B: apps/cloud-builder (no-code entry point)
items.description: Hosted chat surface at /build inside tenant-workspace. Agent driven by sdk-agent-runtime + sdk-ai-gateway with the MCP server's tools as its toolset. Flow: search blueprints → present matches → clarifying questions → confirm → spawn sandbox in tenant pool → install → return URL. Confirm-by-default with opt-in autonomous mode per Q-7 (per-session $ ceiling, destructive ops always confirm). Pack-aware guardrails via sdk-policy. Pricing per Q-4: tier inclusion (3/20/∞) + metered overage. Source: PRD §5.9. Closes FR-CB-1..6, AC-5, AC-8.

items.title: P9 · E5 — Layer 4A: @projexlight/cli (developer entry point)
items.description: Developer-facing CLI. Distributed via npx-only for v1 per Q-6 (native binaries deferred to P10) plus one-line installer that auto-installs Node. Commands: projex login (OAuth device flow + OS keychain), projex init (auto-config Claude Code/Cursor/Windsurf MCP files), projex install, projex blueprint apply, projex deploy (with snapshot + rollback), projex logs, projex registry refresh. Source: PRD §5.5. Closes FR-CLI-1..8, AC-4, AC-10.

items.title: P9 · E4 — Layer 3: Vertical Blueprint Library
items.description: Declarative compositions of SDKs that scaffold runnable vertical applications. Blueprint schema (YAML), installer with clarifying-question runner, semver-tier auto-upgrade policy (Q-3 decision), and 6 pilot blueprints: revops-crm (CLI+cloud-agent demo pilot), field-dispatch, claims-intake, b2b-analytics, patient-portal, prd-management (Projexlight dogfood pilot). Each blueprint = SDK list + scaffold templates + seed data + smoke tests. Source: PRD §5.4. Closes FR-BP-1..5, AC-9.

items.title: P9 · E3 — Layer 2B: MCP Servers (hosted + local)
items.description: Two MCP servers with the same wire protocol. Hosted services/registry-mcp owns writes (scaffold, deploy) + tenant-scoped reads, SSE transport (Q-2 decision), per-region. Local @projexlight/registry-mcp-local is CLI-bundled, stdio transport, caches catalog for offline reads, proxies writes to hosted. Cohabits with existing projex_dev_mcp/projex_test_mcp without tool-name collisions. Distributed under projexcloud/ Docker namespace per Q-11. Source: PRD §5.3 + §5.3b + §5.6. Closes FR-MCP-1..8, FR-MCP-L1..6, FR-COHAB-1..3, AC-6, AC-7, AC-12, AC-13.

items.title: P9 · E2 — Layer 2A: Registry Catalog + Embedding Build
items.description: @projexlight/sdk-registry — build-time scanner that walks packages/* and services/* manifests, validates them, produces a normalized catalog JSON + an embedding index (bge-small-en-v1.5 via @huggingface/transformers per Q-1 decision). Exposes runtime API (loadRegistry, searchByIntent, findCompatibleSdks, getScaffold). Required by E3 (MCP serves this catalog) and E4 (blueprints compose from it). Source: PRD §5.2. Closes FR-REG-1..6, AC-2, AC-3.

items.title: P9 · E1 — Layer 1: SDK Capability Manifest
items.description: The foundation of P9 (SDK Discoverability & AI Builder). Defines and enforces the machine-readable capability manifest every SDK ships. Without this layer no AI agent — local or cloud — can reason about what SDKs are available. Owns: @projexlight/sdk-capability package (schema + TypeScript types + validator + scaffold CLI), the CI gate that rejects any SDK PR without a valid sdk-capability.json, and the manifest-diff utility for breaking-change detection. Closes FR-CAP-1..5 and is the explicit dependency for E2/E3/E4. Source: docs/v3.1/prd/P9-SDK-Discoverability-AI-Builder.md §5.1. Closes AC-1.

items.title: Complete Admin Portals: projexcloud-admin + tenant-admin
items.description: Fill in every page advertised on the two admin portal home tiles that wasn't yet built. projexcloud-admin (port 3100, platform-operator console) needs /pools, /invoices, /webhooks, /approvals, /audit. tenant-admin (port 3200, tenant-operator console) needs /members, /api-keys, /webhooks, /approvals, /connectors, /consent. Each page is server-rendered Next.js 14 App Router with server actions that hit the existing api-gateway under ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN (projexcloud-admin) or tenant-scoped JWT (tenant-admin). Coverage today: ~58% on projexcloud-admin (7/12), ~42% on tenant-admin (5/12). This epic brings both to 100% of advertised sections.

items.title: Phase 8: Deployment Variants (BYOK / Sovereign / On-Prem / Active-Active)
items.description: P8 ships 4 deployment variants for enterprise and regulated buyers — runs in parallel with P3-P7 once Vault + Pool Router exist. Variant A (BYOK/CMEK): customer's CMK becomes the wrapping key for the Tenant Key, revoke = data undecryptable. Variant B (Sovereign Cloud): isolated regions with no data/control-plane leak, partner-operated (FedRAMP, IL5, China PIPL, EU sovereign). Variant C (On-Prem/Air-Gapped): single-cluster K8s distribution with local LLM (Ollama/vLLM), signed quarterly bundles, no phone-home. Variant D (Active-Active Tier-G+): RPO <= 5s, RTO <= 60s, sync replication for audit/payment, async for everything else, monthly chaos drills. No new SDKs in the SDK estate sense; instead variant-specific schema additions + extensions to sdk-vault, sdk-pool-router, sdk-ai-gateway, sdk-webhook, sdk-billing + 2 new packages (sdk-sovereign, sdk-onprem). Anchor docs: docs/v3.1/prd/P8-Deployment-Variants.md, docs/v3.1/datamodel/P8-Deployment-Variants-DataModel.html, docs/v3.1/Architecture-v3.1.html §22A. Phase window: parallel from week 22+.

items.title: Phase 6A Remediation · closed-phase residual gaps
items.description: P6A exit gates G7 + G12 are closed but four residual gaps surfaced during the P6B audit on 2026-05-24: (G-9) kill-switch flag-evaluator not wired into the agent runtime hot path despite the schema column (FR-AGW-7 risk-mitigation primitive); (G-11) capability-token signing key rotation scheduler missing, leaving Risk R-2 unmitigated (FR-ART-1, Q-2); (FR-SEM-9) sdk-mcp-bridge → sdk-semantic CapabilityGraph auto-registration still a stub returning is_stub:true; (S-2) sdk-agent-runtime's package.json missing the workspace dep on sdk-ai-gateway despite importing from it. Each gap is small but compliance-relevant. Window: weeks 41-43 (parallel to P6B executors). Anchor docs: docs/v3.1/prd/P6A-AI-Isolation-MCP.md §5.1/5.4 + docs/v3.1/gaps/p6a-gaps.md.

items.title: Phase 7 / Wave 7: Field + Evidence + Hyperscale
items.description: P7 ships the field-grade SDKs (Storm, Dispatch, Assignment, Lead Scoring, Evidence, Diagnostic Telemetry), closes G10 (pool federation runtime) and G11 (Iceberg lakehouse full federation), flips the meter from soft caps to hard caps (DENY), and ships the final HDK modules (measure + watermark). Evidence is the last domain SDK because its chain-of-custody depends on every encryption tier, audit chain, and lineage edge being in place. Phase window: weeks 44-50. Anchor docs: docs/v3.1/prd/P7-Field-Hyperscale.md, docs/v3.1/datamodel/P7-Field-Hyperscale-DataModel.html, docs/v3.1/Architecture-v3.1.html (§10 encryption, §22A deployment variants), docs/v3.1/SDK-Build-Plan-v3.1.html §W7. Depends on P6B exit gate green (lineage projection + Iceberg partial), Vault + Audit + Geo + Media + Device + Engagement stable, weather API contract (NOAA/DTN/Weather Underground), legal review of evidence-export format per jurisdiction.

items.title: Phase 6B / Wave 6 second half: Knowledge + Semantic + Analytics + Snowflake
items.description: P6B fills out the knowledge + reasoning + analytics stack on top of P6A's safe agent substrate. Closes G8 (cross-pool lineage projection) and G9 (SemanticIntent + SemanticPolicy). Ships 7 new SDKs (sdk-knowledge-rag, sdk-parsing, sdk-conversation, sdk-recommendation, sdk-lineage, sdk-semantic, connector-snowflake), one modified SDK (sdk-analytics with Iceberg lakehouse layer), and 2 new services (lineage-projector, semantic-service). Anchor docs: docs/v3.1/prd/P6B-Knowledge-Semantic.md, docs/v3.1/datamodel/P6B-Knowledge-Semantic-DataModel.html, docs/v3.1/Architecture-v3.1.html, docs/v3.1/SDK-Build-Plan-v3.1.html. Phase window: weeks 40-44. Depends on P6A exit gate green.

items.title: Phase 5 / Wave 5: Engagement (Domain Layer) + Enterprise Connectors
items.description: P5 ships the domain layer that every vertical builds on top of: Encounter (L5) + Relationship (L6) lifecycles + 6 thin engagement SDKs (CRM · Content · Service Request · Event · Campaign · Social) that all reference encounter_id rather than reinventing visit/order/session primitives. P5 also ships the 8 enterprise connectors (Salesforce · M365 · GWorkspace · Jira · Linear · Zendesk · HubSpot · Zoom) so customers' existing tools plug into ProjexCloud immediately. HDK editors (scanner · image · video) round out field workflows. Anchor docs: docs/v3.1/prd/P5-Engagement-Connectors.md, docs/v3.1/datamodel/P5-Engagement-Connectors-DataModel.html, docs/v3.1/SDK-Build-Plan-v3.1.html. Phase window: weeks 29-35. No new gates closed; depends on P4 exit gate + sdk-connectors framework + at least one vertical team ready (Healthcare or Realty).

items.title: Wave 4 / Phase 4: Operational Core + Billing + Integration Framework
items.description: P4 turns the platform billable + integrable + operationally complete. Operational SDKs (Media, Notification, Payment, Workflow, Search) run through meter + pool router. NEW v3.1: sdk-billing (invoices, showback, reprice-dry-run), sdk-webhook (HMAC + DLQ + replay), sdk-approval (routing + SLA escalation), sdk-tenant-lifecycle (provision/suspend/offboard state machine), sdk-connectors framework + first connector-slack. HDK camera + map land. Meter switches emit-only -> soft caps (WARN headers). ProjexCloud Admin + Tenant Admin Portal MVPs deploy. Anchor: docs/v3.1/prd/P4-Operational-Billing.md + docs/v3.1/datamodel/P4-Operational-Billing-DataModel.html + SDK-Build-Plan-v3.1.html W4. Window: weeks 22-29.

items.title: Phase 3 / Wave 3: Canonical Entities + Privacy Ops + HDK Foundation
items.description: P3 closes G5 (person_pool_residency registry powering DSAR fan-out) and G6 (Conflict Resolution Model implemented in hdk-sync). Ships sdk-profile (bands re-homed to App Identity L2; Secure Data on Master Person L1 with per-field envelope encryption), sdk-persona (L2/L3/L4 CRUD), sdk-identity-resolver (single canonical resolveIdentityContext entry point reading the P2 Identity Projection), sdk-data-rights (DSAR/erasure workflow + person_pool_residency), sdk-geo (canonical address_id + PostGIS), sdk-device (canonical device_uuid + attestation), sdk-feature-flags (per-tenant flags + kill switches), plus the HDK foundation track (hdk-idp / hdk-permissions / hdk-diagnostic) and the load-bearing hdk-sync (offline write queue + replay engine with five conflict strategies: CRDT/LWW/merge/event-sourcing/human-review). Anchor docs: docs/v3.1/prd/P3-Canonical-Privacy-HDK.md, docs/v3.1/datamodel/P3-Canonical-Privacy-HDK-DataModel.html, docs/v3.1/SDK-Build-Plan-v3.1.html. Phase window: weeks 15-22.

items.title: Wave 2: Identity Triad (MDM + ABAC + Consent) + ReBAC
items.description: Six-layer identity at hyperscale: sdk-tenant (extended hierarchy: Reseller + sub-tenant + BU + GeoNode + RoleTemplate + FiscalPeriod), sdk-identity (OIDC + MDM + JWT + SAML/SCIM + social IdP + impersonation), sdk-consent, sdk-policy (ABAC + IQL DSL), sdk-rebac (relationship graph + traversal budget + caching), sdk-api-keys (programmatic access). Plus the Identity Projection System (G4 closer) for sub-ms identity resolution. Per SDK-Build-Plan v3.1 Wave 2 (weeks 9-15).

items.title: Wave 0: Foundations
items.description: Foundation packages every Wave 1+ SDK consumes: @projexlight/contracts (typed source of truth), config, telemetry, i18n, design-system, branding, plus pnpm + turbo workspace tooling. Per SDK-Build-Plan v3.1 Wave 0 (weeks 1-3).

items.title: Audit & Telemetry
items.description: Append-only audit ledger, tamper-evident hash chain, and a universal emit-only meter gate for basic telemetry.
items.business_value: Medium - provides compliance and observability primitives for the MVP

items.title: Vault & Secrets SDK
items.description: Typed KMS facade, 7-tier key hierarchy, envelope encryption helpers, and secret lifecycle ops for the MVP.
items.business_value: High - secures secrets and keys required by the product

items.title: Core MVP: Authentication, Pool Routing & Event Contracts
items.description: Provides user identity, tenant/app pool routing, event envelope handling, and an emit-only meter gate to enable end-to-end user flows for the MVP.
items.business_value: High - enables users to register, authenticate, route traffic to tenant-specific DSNs, emit typed events, and meter usage.
